environment.description: Node.js 18 container running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. No WAF attached. ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 4000. The service is exposed via a public-facing ALB DNS endpoint. lodash version 4.17.20 installed. No input validation middleware.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (forward all to target group)
config.network: public subnet, no NACLs beyond default
